test_item_verbatim: When the Surround View Camera soft button pressed, the HU shall send an on-change $SVC_SoftBtn_Rq$ = [Pressed] within <Tsend> of keypress.

tcs.tc_title: SVC_SoftBtn_Rq sent on keypress, press the virtual button and read the bus for SVC_SoftBtn_Rq
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Surround_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The shift lever is in P
4. No camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Connect a bus analyzer to the vehicle bus and start recording
2. Press the virtual Surround View Camera button on the HU display
3. Read the bus analyzer recording and check the SVC_SoftBtn_Rq signal and the time between the keypress and its transmission
tcs.expected_result:
1. The bus analyzer is recording the vehicle bus
2. The virtual Surround View Camera button registers the press
3. PENDING: DR-CAM-j an on-change SVC_SoftBtn_Rq = Pressed is sent within Tsend of the keypress (signal, message and Tsend value all have no source)
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item:
When the Surround View Camera soft button pressed, the HU shall send an on-change $SVC_SoftBtn_Rq$ = [Pressed] within <Tsend> of keypress.

(SVC_SoftBtn_Rq sent on keypress, press the virtual button and read the bus for SVC_SoftBtn_Rq)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 CFTS092 `SYS-RA-CAM-085`（ObjectID 4781650，Surround View Camera 節）之「按下 SVC 軟鍵後於 <Tsend> 內送出 on-change `$SVC_SoftBtn_Rq$ = [Pressed]`」。**`SVC_SoftBtn_Rq` 於 `forms/` 四本 DBC 全文字面掃描零命中**，其承載 message、raw 值與 `<Tsend>` 之值皆無來源，三者一併標 `PENDING: DR-CAM-j`。觀察手段依 §5.4 之兩行式以 bus analyzer 書寫，不造命令。不成立側（`[Not Pressed]`，`SYS-RA-CAM-086`／`-087`）之承接列為 `SWE-CAM-003`（R-CAM10），屬 batch02 之範圍，本列不承。本列依 **R-CAM13(c)** 落 Test Set `Auxiliary Cameras`（framework Part VIII 第 10 組，CAM-06 重開）；其 SWE 列 `SWE-CAM-016` 於 Layer 2 仍歸 `Display Arbitration`，「組 ↔ SWE 列」與「TC ↔ Test Set」於本組分離。A-CA28 之「不生成」處置作廢。
